WITH incoming AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS request
), canonical AS (
  SELECT CASE request->>'template_type'
    WHEN 'emotive_text' THEN jsonb_set(request, '{template_type}', to_jsonb(U&'\611F\6027\6587\5B57'::text))
    WHEN 'simple_logic' THEN jsonb_set(request, '{template_type}', to_jsonb(U&'\7B80\5355\903B\8F91'::text))
    WHEN 'repeated_instruction' THEN jsonb_set(request, '{template_type}', to_jsonb(U&'\91CD\590D\6307\4EE4'::text))
    WHEN 'complex_task' THEN jsonb_set(request, '{template_type}', to_jsonb(U&'\590D\6742\4EFB\52A1'::text))
    WHEN 'objective_fair' THEN jsonb_set(request, '{template_type}', to_jsonb(U&'\5BA2\89C2\516C\6B63'::text))
    ELSE request
  END AS request
  FROM incoming
), save_projection AS (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN c.request->>'action' = 'save_model_template'
      AND e.id IS NOT NULL
    THEN c.request || jsonb_build_object(
      'provider_base_url', e.provider_base_url,
      'model_name', e.model_name,
      'api_key_ref', CASE e.api_key_ref_sha256
        WHEN encode(digest(convert_to('n8n-credential:openai-account-v1', 'UTF8'), 'sha256'), 'hex') THEN 'n8n-credential:openai-account-v1'
        WHEN encode(digest(convert_to('n8n-credential:relaycove-v1', 'UTF8'), 'sha256'), 'hex') THEN 'n8n-credential:relaycove-v1'
      END
    )
    ELSE c.request
  END AS request
  FROM canonical AS c
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT e.id, e.provider_base_url, e.model_name, e.api_key_ref_sha256
    FROM public.model_connection_test_evidence AS e
    WHERE e.id = (c.request->>'connection_test_evidence_id')::uuid
      AND e.local_operator_id = (c.request->>'local_operator_id')::uuid
      AND e.test_succeeded
      AND e.api_key_ref_sha256 IN (encode(digest(convert_to('n8n-credential:openai-account-v1', 'UTF8'), 'sha256'), 'hex'), encode(digest(convert_to('n8n-credential:relaycove-v1', 'UTF8'), 'sha256'), 'hex'))
  ) AS e ON c.request->>'action' = 'save_model_template'
), test_projection AS (
  SELECT c.request, CASE
    WHEN c.request->>'action' = 'test_connection' THEN jsonb_build_object(
      'route', 'test',
      'request', jsonb_build_object(
        'local_operator_id', c.request->>'local_operator_id',
        'provider_base_url', c.request->>'provider_base_url',
        'model_name', c.request->>'model_name',
        'api_key_ref', c.request->>'api_key_ref'
      )
    )
    ELSE NULL
  END AS test_result
  FROM save_projection AS c
), book_banner AS (
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', true,
    'book_banner', jsonb_build_object(
      'book_id', bp.id,
      'title', bp.title,
      'genre_main', bp.genre_main,
      'stage_code', bp.stage_code,
      'run_status', bp.run_status,
      'target_words', bp.target_words,
      'chapter_words', bp.chapter_words,
      'expected_chapter_count', CASE
        WHEN bp.target_words IS NULL OR bp.chapter_words IS NULL OR bp.chapter_words <= 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ceil(bp.target_words::numeric / bp.chapter_words)::integer
      END,
      'formal_chapter_count', formal_chapters.formal_chapter_count,
      'progress_percent', CASE
        WHEN bp.target_words IS NULL OR bp.target_words <= 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE round((formal_chapters.formal_word_count::numeric * 100) / bp.target_words, 1)
      END,
      'latest_chapter', CASE
        WHEN latest.chapter_id IS NULL THEN NULL
        ELSE jsonb_build_object(
          'chapter_id', latest.chapter_id,
          'chapter_index', latest.chapter_index,
          'title', latest.title,
          'word_count', latest.word_count,
          'prose_summary', latest.prose_summary
        )
      END,
      'formal_word_count', formal_chapters.formal_word_count,
      'formal_asset_count', assets.formal_asset_count,
      'formal_l1a_count', l1a.formal_l1a_count,
      'planned_l1a_count', CASE
        WHEN bp.target_words IS NULL OR bp.chapter_words IS NULL OR bp.chapter_words <= 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ceil(ceil(bp.target_words::numeric / bp.chapter_words) / 3)::integer
      END
    )
  ) AS result
  FROM test_projection
  JOIN public.book_project AS bp
    ON bp.id = (request->>'book_id')::uuid
   AND bp.local_operator_id = (request->>'local_operator_id')::uuid
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      count(*)::integer AS formal_chapter_count,
      COALESCE(sum(ch.word_count), 0)::bigint AS formal_word_count
    FROM public.chapter_header AS ch
    JOIN public.chapter_version AS cv
      ON cv.chapter_id = ch.id
     AND cv.book_id = ch.book_id
     AND cv.version_state = 'formal'
     AND cv.is_formal
     AND cv.is_valid
     AND NOT cv.is_shadow
    WHERE ch.book_id = bp.id
  ) AS formal_chapters ON true
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ch.id AS chapter_id, ch.chapter_index, ch.title, ch.word_count, cv.prose_summary
    FROM public.chapter_header AS ch
    JOIN public.chapter_version AS cv
      ON cv.chapter_id = ch.id
     AND cv.book_id = ch.book_id
     AND cv.version_state = 'formal'
     AND cv.is_formal
     AND cv.is_valid
     AND NOT cv.is_shadow
    WHERE ch.book_id = bp.id
    ORDER BY ch.chapter_index DESC, ch.id DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS latest ON true
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT count(*)::integer AS formal_asset_count
    FROM public.narrative_asset AS na
    WHERE na.book_id = bp.id
      AND na.is_formal
      AND na.is_valid
      AND NOT na.is_shadow
  ) AS assets ON true
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT count(*)::integer AS formal_l1a_count
    FROM public.l1a_unit AS lu
    WHERE lu.book_id = bp.id
      AND lu.is_formal
      AND lu.is_valid
      AND NOT lu.is_shadow
      AND lu.is_locked
  ) AS l1a ON true
  WHERE request->>'action' = 'book_banner'
)
SELECT CASE
  WHEN request->>'action' = 'book_banner' THEN jsonb_build_object(
    'route', 'respond',
    'result', COALESCE(
      (SELECT result FROM book_banner LIMIT 1),
      jsonb_build_object(
        'ok', false,
        'error', jsonb_build_object('code', 'SCOPE_REJECTED', 'message', 'The selected book is unavailable.')
      )
    )
  )
  WHEN request->>'action' = 'test_connection' THEN COALESCE(
    test_result,
    jsonb_build_object('route', 'respond', 'result', jsonb_build_object(
      'ok', false,
      'error', jsonb_build_object('code', 'INVALID_REQUEST', 'message', 'A controlled model test requires a valid address and model name.')
    ))
  )
  ELSE jsonb_build_object(
    'route', 'respond',
    'result', CASE WHEN request->>'action' = 'operator'
      THEN public.rpc_get_local_operator(request - 'action')
      ELSE public.rpc_workbench(request)
    END
  )
END AS result
FROM test_projection;

parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS request
), normalized AS (
  SELECT
    (request->>'local_operator_id')::uuid AS local_operator_id,
    NULLIF(btrim(request->>'provider_base_url'), '') AS provider_base_url,
    NULLIF(btrim(request->>'model_name'), '') AS model_name,
    NULLIF(btrim(request->>'api_key_ref'), '') AS api_key_ref,
    COALESCE((request->>'http_status')::integer, 0) AS http_status,
    COALESCE((request->>'test_succeeded')::boolean, false) AS test_succeeded
  FROM input
), recorded AS (
  SELECT
    n.*,
    public.v7_record_model_connection_test(
      n.local_operator_id,
      n.provider_base_url,
      n.model_name,
      n.api_key_ref,
      n.test_succeeded,
      jsonb_build_object(
        'source', 'n8n-controlled-http-test',
        'http_status', n.http_status::text,
        'error_code', CASE WHEN n.test_succeeded THEN NULL ELSE 'CONNECTION_FAILED' END
      )
    ) AS evidence_id
  FROM normalized AS n
)
SELECT CASE
  WHEN test_succeeded THEN jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', true,
    'connection_test', jsonb_build_object(
      'connection_test_evidence_id', evidence_id,
      'provider_base_url', provider_base_url,
      'model_name', model_name,
      'http_status', http_status
    )
  )
  ELSE jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', false,
    'error', jsonb_build_object(
      'code', 'CONNECTION_FAILED',
      'message', '受控模型连接测试失败，配置没有保存。'
    )
  )
END AS result
FROM recorded;
